scope_summary: Atomic precheck for the isolated OpenRouter key lifecycle on the existing API-key Settings surface. Verify exact-key validation-state authority, save/replace atomicity, official content-free key validation contract, OpenRouter-only deletion, secret-safe public responses and logs, and no chat/model/telemetry/production activation. No credential access or live provider call.
acceptance_focus: target task identity is unique and consistent with the approved parent Spec
raw key storage and deletion are restricted to Janus-Projekt/openrouter while all other credentials and the ChatGPT card remain unchanged
Janus-owned restart-safe validation state is bound to the exact stored key and cannot inherit stale VALID state
401 maps to INVALID while technical or incomplete validation maps to UNVERIFIED without retry; public and evidence surfaces remain secret-free
the implementation remains within the seven bound files and does not activate chat, models, telemetry, or production
evidence_focus: mocked backend contracts for save replace delete success 401 timeout network 429 5xx malformed response no retry exact-key state binding and provider isolation
sentinel-secret leak checks across response logs exceptions persisted metadata and browser-visible output
headed mocked Settings E2E for masked presence and VALID INVALID UNVERIFIED states plus ChatGPT-card non-interference
Python and JavaScript syntax plus scoped diff checks; no live OpenRouter call or real key
